reviews.name: Rebecca Goldman
reviews.text: I would recommend SYB to anyone looking for an adventure, to meet new people, and try something new. I went on my first trip with them to Chamonix and everything was amazing - from the leaders (shoutout Bradford, Alex, Ryan, and Samara), to the group, activities, and location everything was planned perfectly. Can’t wait for my next trip!

reviews.name: Johnny D
reviews.text: Thrilling experience with active travel mates who want to have a great time. Leaders are all in and hold nothing back in providing a great experience. I did the chamonix trip and would love to do another ski trip with them.

reviews.name: Alexandra Garcia
reviews.text:
Just returned from an amazing week of skiing with Surf Yoga Beer in Chamonix, and I cannot wait to book my next trip with this group! SYB was my first group trip as a solo traveller, and it was such a delight meeting and connecting with like-minded people throughout the week. Every part of the trip was thoughtfully curated and executed, and I have to give a special kudos to Bradford, one of the trip leaders, for consistently uplifting the group with positive energy and inclusivity. I am excited to return to this trip in 2026!

If you’re looking to join a group trip, I highly recommend SYB above all!

reviews.name: Henry Berry
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer is an incredible travel company and a life experience everyone should have.  From the moment you arrive on the trip, it feels like a family you have known for years. The organisation and the team are amazing. The themed events certainly bring everyone together. Bradford, Alex, Ryan and Samara on the Chamonix 2025 trip were amazing leaders and organised the trip allowing everyone to switch off their brain and just enjoy. Certainly will be travelling with the SYB crew again in the future.

reviews.name: Tyler Krist
reviews.text:
I recently spent New Year’s Eve with Surf Yoga Beer in Nicaragua, and it was absolutely magical. I stayed in the Tortuga villa, which offered breathtaking views every morning and the serene sound of howler monkeys in the distance—truly the best way to wake up. The villa was just a 5-minute walk to the beach, making it super convenient to carry my surfboard down and hit the waves. The surf conditions were perfect, with sand-bottom breaks that accommodate everyone, from beginners to advanced surfers, creating a safe and fun environment.

Each morning began with freshly brewed coffee and fruit, a delightful treat to ease into the day before breakfast. This small detail really set the tone for the relaxed, yet energizing atmosphere of the trip.

The real highlight of my experience, however, was the people. While many of us arrived solo (myself included), the warm and inviting energy of the group made it easy to connect. Any nerves quickly faded thanks to the incredible leaders and the variety of planned activities, which kept us laughing, bonding, and making lifelong memories.

I’ve already signed up for the Ski Yoga Beer trip in Chamonix, and I cannot wait for the next adventure!

Cheers to more amazing experiences with Surf Yoga Beer!

reviews.name: Matthew Cohen (CohenComedy)
reviews.text: I went to Chamonix with SYB, March 2024, and had an incredible time connecting with old friends and making a ton of new connections, all while shredding the Alps and eating amazing French food! It’s a well run organization with a lot of fun to be had by all!

reviews.name: Sara O'Brien
reviews.text: I joined the SYB Chamonix, France ski trip and am so glad I did. Each lead brought their own insight and unique energy that positively impacted our group’s experience. I was able to trust that the logistics for the trip were taken care of and that is a big plus for me. This trip also offered a lot of guidance/insight about the mountains we skied/boarded which I really appreciated. And we always found a brilliant spot for après ski which is nearly as important 😂 beyond all done that, I also met some pretty awesome friends from all over. Can’t wait to join another adventure in the future.

reviews.name: Mary Kate Gorman
reviews.text: I am a huge fan of SYB.  I attended the summer 2022 Amalfi Coast trip and had a blast - great friends, great food, great fun.  Looking forward to the Chamonix trip.  Can't recommend enough, wish I found this community sooner. xo
